newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total to build lubricant plant in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Total to build lubricant plant in Thailand.

text.p: French oil company Total said on Wednesday it had signed an agreement with the Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) to build a lubricants mixing plant.
The plant, to be owned 30 percent by Total and 70 percent by PTT, will have an initial capacity of 60 million litres a year and will come on stream in the mid-1998, Total said in a statement.
The total investment will be 60 million francs.
The products will be marketed by PTT and Total Lubricants Thailand in a domestic market that is expanding by seven percent to eight percent a year.
The plant will be built at the Sriracha oil terminal operated by PTT and located next to PTT's Thai Lub Base plant which will supply the lub bases.
Total and PTT are already partners in Thailand, Burma and Vietnam in such areas as exploration and production.
